refinement_plan_1.analysis: Review feedback highlights three high-priority issues: (1) Organization and Item classes lack detailed data properties for CQ5 and CQ8; (2) SHACLConstraint class is present but lacks explicit individuals/axioms for mandatory fields and logical consistency (CQ13); (3) General class axioms (GCAs) and equivalentClass axioms are missing for key classes. Medium priorities include expanding EDIFACT technical vocabulary and code mappings, and adding advanced property characteristics. No constraint violations or OWL2 compliance issues are present, but the ontology would benefit from richer axiomatization.

high_priority_suggestions.action: Add data properties to Organization (legal name, VAT ID, contact info, legal form, etc.) and Item (description, product code, brand, etc.)
Define explicit SHACLConstraint individuals for mandatory fields and logical consistency (e.g., presence of invoice number, at least one buyer, sum of line item net prices = invoice amount)
Add GCAs and equivalentClass axioms for Invoice and OrganizationRoleAssignment

medium_priority_suggestions.action: Expand code mappings and technical vocabulary for EDIFACT segments/elements (e.g., add more example segment types, element codes)

low_priority_suggestions.action: Add advanced property characteristics (transitive, symmetric) and temporal modeling (validity period for roles)
